meta.name: The Castle
meta.blurb: The lord behind his walls, if they'll let you in.

activities.name: Tilt in the yard
activities.blurb: The garrison drills at dusk and takes the measure of any hand that joins them. The yard remembers who stood in it.

activities.name: Join the banquet
activities.blurb: The lord feasts nightly to prove there is nothing to fear. Sit low, eat carefully, and watch what the great pretend not to see.

activities.name: Gossip with the staff
activities.blurb: The steward and the servants know every stone of the keep — and which doors the lord pretends are not there.
